sources.title: Qwen 3.5 9B | AI Model | There's An AI For That
sources.snippet: Qwen3.5-9B is a post-trained vision-language model with 9B parameters, 32 layers, and a Gated DeltaNet plus Gated Attention hybrid layout, built for multimodal instruction-following and tool calling, with 262,144 native context length and stated extensibility up to about 1,010,000 tokens.

sources.snippet: Qwen3.5-9B is a multimodal foundation model from the Qwen3.5 family, built to deliver strong reasoning, coding, and visual understanding within an efficient 9B-parameter architecture. sources.title: Qwen3.5-9B - Qwen (Alibaba) AI Model | ValorGPT
sources.snippet: Qwen3.5-9B is a premium large language model developed by Qwen (Alibaba). With a 262K tokens context window, this model excels at complex reasoning and step-by-step problem solving, generates and debugs code across multiple programming languages, understands and analyzes images alongside text, processes extensive documents and conversations.
